meta.target: Meta Astryx theme layer (CSS custom-property overrides)

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white in Light, warm near-black in Dark.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart plots. Sits on surface-0 with line-1 as its edge, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells, table header rows, code and quote backgrounds, inactive track of a comparison bar.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The one inverted surface: the report masthead and a single callout per page. Text on it is ink-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and figures on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: captions, chart axis labels, table cells, methodology notes, on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted: eyebrows, footnotes, source lines, disabled labels, on surface-0 and surface-1. Never body copy.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse and on accent-strong.

tokens.name: line-1
tokens.usage: Hairline card edges, table rules, chart gridlines. Decorative: not held to a contrast floor.

tokens.name: line-2
tokens.usage: Meaningful borders: input edges, chart axis baseline, divider between report sections. 3:1 on surface-0 and surface-1.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The teal that carries the report: links, the active filter, the highlighted bar, the one number on a stat tile. As text it reads on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Primary button fill and the selected segment. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent-strong.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Accent tint: hovered row, selected chip background, the band behind a pulled quote. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element. Solid, 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Chart slot 1. This year, or the headline series. Fixed order: a series keeps its slot when others are filtered out.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Chart slot 2. Last year, or the comparison series.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Chart slot 3. Third series only; beyond three, fold to Other or split into small multiples.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Chart slot 4. Last resort; prefer small multiples.

tokens.name: series-muted
tokens.usage: Every non-highlighted bar when one bar is the point. Also the remainder of a part-to-whole bar.

tokens.name: seq-1
tokens.usage: Sequential step 1 (least). One teal ramp for magnitude, light to dark; never a rainbow.

tokens.name: seq-2
tokens.usage: Sequential step 2.

tokens.name: seq-3
tokens.usage: Sequential step 3.

tokens.name: seq-4
tokens.usage: Sequential step 4.

tokens.name: seq-5
tokens.usage: Sequential step 5 (most).

tokens.name: div-neg
tokens.usage: Diverging negative pole (ochre). Use for a decline, a gap, a shortfall.

tokens.name: div-mid
tokens.usage: Diverging midpoint. Always a neutral, never a hue.

tokens.name: div-pos
tokens.usage: Diverging positive pole (teal). Use for growth, adoption, an increase.

tokens.name: status-good
tokens.usage: Good state. A blue-shifted green so it leaves the red-green axis that status-critical sits on. Ships with a check icon and a word; never a chart series.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state. Ships with an icon and a word; never a chart series.

tokens.name: status-critical
tokens.usage: Critical state and form errors. Ships with an icon and a word; never a chart series. Told apart from status-good by lightness and a blue-shifted green, not hue alone.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number or one-line thesis per report page. Never more than one on a screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section titles of the report; the audience name on a landing page.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Chart titles that make a claim, pulled quotes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and panel titles; the subhead under a display style.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Half of designers have shipped AI-generated code to production.
styles.usage: Lead paragraph of a section; the summary a stakeholder reads if they read nothing else.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Peer learning tripled year over year, from 24% to 80%.
styles.usage: Body copy, table cells, tooltip text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, chart axis labels, legend labels, methodology notes, in ink-2.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title or stat: the audience, the section, the source. In ink-3 or accent.

styles.name: figure-xl
styles.usage: The number on a stat tile. Tabular by nature; never in the serif.

styles.name: figure-md
styles.usage: Inline comparisons and the direct label on a highlighted bar.

styles.name: figure-sm
styles.usage: Axis tick values, sample sizes, table numerals, direct labels on secondary bars.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Report layouts step by 8 and 16; chart internals by 4.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a bar and its direct label; the surface gap between adjacent bars (2px is half a step: use space-0.5 below).

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: The surface-colored gap between stacked segments and between adjacent bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between eyebrow and title; between legend swatch and label; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding vertical; tooltip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on small screens; gap between stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding at desktop; gap between a chart and its caption.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page gutter at desktop; space above a display-xl.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a body-copy column.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, inputs, the data-end of a bar (rounded on the free end only, square at the baseline).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, tooltips, table containers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart panels. Nothing larger: the system is square-shouldered, not pill-shaped.

shadow.note: Elevation is drawn with line-1 and surface steps. The one shadow is for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Tooltips, menus and popovers only. Cards never carry it.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Card edges, table rules, gridlines in line-1.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: The chart baseline in line-2.

tokens.name: stroke-line
tokens.usage: Line-chart series; the focus ring.

tokens.name: bar-thickness
tokens.usage: Horizontal bar height in a comparison chart. Thin marks: never thicker than 28px.
